name: NusukChat 2.8.6: the six _Chat Container Master states, as Figma draws them
source: The DL Advisor's walkthrough of _Chat Container Master (80451:18766) on 18 November 2026.

states.Status=Chat, Type=Nusuk/BG (80451:18764): Nusuk owns the message or question and the user has not answered yet. 24×27 bot at the start, aligned to the top of the bubble, 12 apart; Body radius Radius/MD with Radius/XS at the top-start corner (next to the bot); footer: time at the start, Actions (copy, helpful, not helpful) at the end when shown.
states.Status=Chat, Type=User/BG (80451:18765): The user has answered. The question moves to the top as a header row (the 12×14 Nusuk mark without eyes, then the question in Notes 14 Regular, text-heading, 12 apart, at the start); 18 below it the answer bubble with the 24 user avatar at the end, aligned to the bottom; Radius/XS at the bottom-end corner; time at the end, beside the avatar.
states.Status=Loading, Type=Nusuk (80451:18763): One side has sent and the other is working, or something runs in the background. Nusuk: the bot at the start with the three dots beside it; User: the avatar at the end with the dots beside it; centred, Space/SM apart, no bubble.

changed.change: bot aligned to the top (was the bottom); tail corner top-start (was bottom-start).
the header row with the 12×14 mark is for answered (user) messages only. On a Nusuk message, question is the bubble's first line (Body 1), and the bot stays.

time follows the reading direction: start for Nusuk, end for the user (it was pinned left-to-right, which put both on the wrong side in Arabic). Time and question header: Notes 14 Regular (was Light).
bot or avatar and dots centred on each other (row class nkc-loading).

native.ios: Nusuk row: HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 12) { bot; bubble }; bubble UnevenRoundedRectangle(topLeading: 8, others 18). User row: VStack(spacing: 18) { question header; HStack(alignment: .bottom, spacing: 12) { bubble; avatar } } with bottomTrailing 8. Footer time .leading for Nusuk, .trailing for the user.
native.android: Nusuk row: Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top, horizontalArrangement = spacedBy(12.dp)); RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 8.dp, others 18.dp). User: Column(spacedBy(18.dp)) { header; Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom) }, bottomEnd = 8.dp. Time TextAlign.Start (Nusuk) / TextAlign.End (user).

breaking: Message with from: 'nusuk' and question no longer renders the header row; the question is inside the bubble.
